manifest.description: dsh-purge 优化版（衍生分支）：在上游 1.1.90 基础上恢复技能库 23 个技能、POC/EXP 知识库与本地靶场白名单，并补齐 nuclei 模板类目筛选与翻页。Derivative branch of dsh-purge — restores the skill library, knowledge base and local-lab allowlist.
manifest.author: dsh-purge maintainers

bundle.text:
# dsh-purge bundle patch
#
# 清洗 + 演练台都在本插件内（lib/redteam、presets/redteam、skills/redteam）。
# 只装 dsh-purge，不外接、不 link 其它红队包。

# 关掉旧的独立红队包行（若用户以前装过 dsh-redteam-mode）
- id: redteam-store
  name: dsh-redteam-store
  disabled: true

- id: redteam-ui
  name: dsh-redteam-ui
  disabled: true

- id: redteam-mode
  name: dsh-redteam-mode
  disabled: true

- id: redteam-mode-store
  name: dsh-redteam-mode/store
  disabled: true

- id: redteam-mode-ui
  name: dsh-redteam-mode/ui
  disabled: true

- id: system-prompt
  config:
    includeHarnessIdentity: false
    personaPrefix: ""
    personaSuffix: ""

# 本体 insert 写在用户层 profile/cordis.patch.yml（postinstall / 演练台自愈补）。
# 这里只改已入队条目的 inject/config。再 insert 一次会 already queued（#152 / #154 / #159）。
- id: dsh-purge
  name: dsh-purge
  inject: [systemPrompt, tools]
  config:
    enabled: true
    autoApplyOnStart: false
    autoUpdateOnStart: false
    autoRevertOnMissing: false
    injectOnce: false
    stripMnemon: true
    verbose: false
    postPrompt: ""
    postPromptOrder: 5100
    autoRetry: true
    retryMax: 3
    autoContinue: false
    continueMax: 3
    continueText: "继续"
    capabilityProtocol: true
    hooksDenyBypass: true
    anchorMode: auto
    subagentControl: true

- insert:
    # 演练台：预设 + 技能落地（本插件 lib/redteam）
    - id: dsh-purge-redteam
      name: dsh-purge/redteam

    # 演练台事实库（SQLite），数据在 $DSH_HOME/redteam
    - id: dsh-purge-redteam-store
      name: dsh-purge/redteam/store
      config:
        root: !!js dshHomePath('redteam')

    # 演练台 HTTP 桥 POST /redteam/api
    - id: dsh-purge-redteam-ui
      name: dsh-purge/redteam/ui

readme.text: ⚔️ DeepSeek Harness cybersecurity red-team tool (dsh-purge-optimized)

> **Derivative branch, not the upstream release.** This repository is based on [HunYiSage/dsh-purge](https://github.com/HunYiSage/dsh-purge) **1.1.90** and restores the skill library (23 skills), the POC/EXP knowledge base, and the local-lab allowlist, plus category filtering and pagination for the nuclei template index. Upstream network-scope rules, DNS checks, game-cheat interception, and the evidence-chain tools are unchanged. Copyright stays with HunYiSage; Apache-2.0. For the upstream build use the upstream repo; install commands below already point at this branch.

Version 1.1.91-opt.1

DeepSeek Harness jailbreak: every model, swap prompts per model. Default prompt for 小码酱. Please star ⭐ If you build on this, see Attribution required.
English | 中文 | 日本語

dsh-purge was originally developed by its author as an independent project. It is now maintained by the **dsh-purge maintainers team**, which handles the codebase, documentation, releases, and security response. All historical commits, issues, and releases are preserved and links remain unchanged; the original author's credit and source record are retained.

The project's boundaries remain unchanged:

- **The open-source build is local-lab only.** Attack tasks are limited to loopback and RFC1918 private addresses. Domains are resolved first (including hosts); every resolved address must be private or loopback. Entries that point a lab name at a public address, failed lookups, or answers that include public addresses are rejected.
- **Game cheats are prohibited**, including aimbots, wallhacks, memory modification, and anti-cheat bypass; both the prompt layer and the session gate enforce this.
- The skill library and knowledge base ship with the package and are on by default: the 23 skills under `skills/redteam/` are synced to `$DSH_HOME/redteam/skills` at startup, and the POC/EXP store lives at `$DSH_HOME/redteam/knowledge.db`. The sidebar has dedicated Knowledge and Skills tabs.

**Derivative branch, upstream credited.** This repository is a derivative of [HunYiSage/dsh-purge](https://github.com/HunYiSage/dsh-purge) 1.1.90. It restores the skill library, the knowledge base, and the local-lab allowlist on top of upstream. Upstream copyright belongs to HunYiSage and stays under Apache License 2.0. Forks and derivative work must credit both upstream [HunYiSage/dsh-purge](https://github.com/HunYiSage/dsh-purge) and this branch [lzzzz666888/dsh-purge-optimized](https://github.com/lzzzz666888/dsh-purge-optimized). **Resale of the original build is prohibited.** Paid resale, re-skinning for store listings, and distribution as a commercial product are not permitted.
Team channel: [t.me/LLM_PoJia](https://t.me/LLM_PoJia), used for announcements and updates.

---

**dsh-purge** is a cybersecurity red-team plugin for the official [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/harness/) already installed on your machine. **1.1.91-opt.1** targets **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2** (0.2.0 still works). **DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 and newer RCs are not supported.** Official **Web** (`dsh web`) and the official **desktop EXE** are both supported. Install and Apply them separately.

Harness does more than forward a prompt. It rewrites prompts, approval gates, sandbox policy, and session migration at runtime. Asking only “will the model answer” treats a host-layer block as a model refusal. This plugin separates those two layers on your own install, for controlled evaluation and for seeing which default policy is too tight.

| You get | What it does |
|---|---|
| **dsh-purge dock** | A button beside the session title opens the right dock. Two pages: Clean and Drill |
| **Clean** | Grouped patch status, Apply / Restore / Uninstall, prompt editor, multiple rule sets |
| **Drill** | Built into the stable release. After authorization: assets and the local environment. This build does not ship skills or the knowledge base. Local lab only |
| **Host policy** | Default copy, permission policy, and tool limits. Official capabilities stay. No second invented identity |
| **On start** | Checks and reapplies. After npm overwrites `node_modules`, you do not hand-edit files |

No hardcoded drive letters. It looks at `$DSH_HOME`, `.dsh` next to the dsh launcher, then `~/.dsh`. It does not patch the Harness source tree. **Apply** on the **Clean** page of **dsh-purge** is what writes the changes. Identity comes from the encrypted prompt shipped in the plugin, the text the prompt box shows by default. The host prompt file is not read.

It only touches the official `@deepseek-ai` packages and local config on the user's machine. It is not a public scanner and not an attack kit for third-party sites. The repo does not ship malware, unauthorized-exploit scripts, or payloads aimed at the public internet.

**1.1.81 and newer target DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.** 0.2.0 still works. Do not apply it to 0.1.x.

- **dsh 0.2.1-rc.2** (official desktop / official `dsh web`): use **1.1.81** or newer. Fixes `{{cwd}}` / `[cwd]` crash, patch #40 match, dropped `toolFilter`, host `dsh-tools` resolve, hostFs fd, desktop helper self-kill, `file:` archive update, Ctrl+Enter steer.
- **dsh 0.2.0-rc.2**: use **1.1.40** or newer; this line also installs.
- **dsh 0.1.7** (incl. rc.1 / rc.2): use **1.1.39** or older — pick the tag on [Releases](https://github.com/lzzzz666888/dsh-purge-optimized/releases).
- **dsh 0.2.1-rc.3 / rc.4 and newer are not supported.** Unmatched patches stay pending or skipped; nothing is rewritten blindly. Stay on **0.2.1-rc.2**.

**Do not use the plugin marketplace.** One-click install on [dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org) or in Settings → Plugin Market fails with `already queued: dsh-purge` and never runs a command. The name is not on the npm registry, so do not `pnpm add dsh-purge`.

Have `dsh` on PATH? One command, one restart, one click. Run the line for the host you open (the desktop EXE is the same with `desktop` instead of `web`):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://codeload.github.com/lzzzz666888/dsh-purge-optimized/tar.gz/refs/heads/master

dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://codeload.github.com/lzzzz666888/dsh-purge-optimized/tar.gz/refs/heads/master
```

1. **Fully quit and reopen** the host you installed into. Web: stop `dsh web` and start it again. Desktop: quit the tray icon too, then open the exe.
2. On that host, click **dsh-purge** beside the session title → **Clean** → **Apply**. A successful Apply restarts the host once.
Done — verify with `/purge status` in chat. If pnpm asks about build scripts, or anything below does not appear, follow the step by step.

**Step 1 — Pick your host.** Official `dsh web` and the official desktop EXE are installed and patched **separately**; only install into the host you actually open.

| What you run | Profile | Install command |
|---|---|---|
| Official `dsh web` | `web` | the `web` line in Quick start |
| Official desktop EXE | `desktop` | the `desktop` line in Quick start |

**Step 2 — Install the plugin.** Use the `codeload.github.com` URL exactly. Do not use `github.com/.../archive`: that 302 makes pnpm fail with `fetch failed`.

Have `dsh`? Run the Quick start line for your profile. If this directory is already a clone, use `.` instead of the URL.

```sh

For AI assistants (install only)

Install the DeepSeek Harness plugin `dsh-purge` into the Web profile only. Do not scan the whole disk, do not read or edit other files, do not apply settings, and do not restart the app. Do not install into the desktop profile. Do not use the plugin marketplace. The name is not on the npm registry; do not `pnpm add dsh-purge`.

**Web (official `dsh web`)**

If `dsh` is on PATH:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://codeload.github.com/lzzzz666888/dsh-purge-optimized/tar.gz/refs/heads/master
```

If `dsh` is missing and pnpm is available, `cd` into `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web` (often `~/.dsh/profiles/web`) and run:

```sh
pnpm add https://codeload.github.com/lzzzz666888/dsh-purge-optimized/tar.gz/refs/heads/master
```

If this directory is already a clone and `dsh` exists, use `dsh plugin --profile web add .`. If neither `dsh` nor pnpm is available, tell the user and stop. After the command finishes, tell the user to fully quit and restart `dsh web`, then open **dsh-purge** beside the session title and **Apply** on **Clean**. Then stop.

**Manual install.** Use this when the command fails or `dsh` is not on PATH. Edit **only the profile for the host you run** — do not touch the other, and do not delete existing bundles.
Full manual steps

**1. Find the `$DSH_HOME` this host uses.** A real home is named `.dsh` (official EXE sometimes `dsh-home`), contains `profiles`, and has at least one `profiles/<name>/package.json`. Check in order: `DSH_HOME` env → `.dsh` next to the install root (portable) → `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh` or `~/.dsh` → `%APPDATA%` / `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeek Harness\dsh-home`. Confirm: `profiles/web/package.json` has `"name": "dsh-profile-web"` (or `dsh-profile-desktop`). Machines often have two homes — use the one that belongs to the host you actually start.

PowerShell to list candidates:

```powershell
$cands = @()
if ($env:DSH_HOME) { $cands += $env:DSH_HOME }
$cands += "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh"
$dsh = Get-Command dsh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

**2. Put the plugin at `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-purge`** (folder must be named `dsh-purge`, with a `package.json` whose `"name"` is `dsh-purge`).

```sh
git clone https://github.com/lzzzz666888/dsh-purge-optimized.git "$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-purge"
```

Without git: download [master.tar.gz](https://github.com/lzzzz666888/dsh-purge-optimized/archive/refs/heads/master.tar.gz), extract, rename `dsh-purge-master` → `dsh-purge`, and place it under `plugins`. If you already have a clone, copy the whole tree — not a few `.js` files.

**3. Edit only that profile's `package.json` — back it up first.** Web → `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json`; desktop → `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/package.json`. Add **only two things**, keeping every existing dependency and bundle:

1. In `dependencies`, add `"dsh-purge": "file:../../plugins/dsh-purge"`
2. At the **end** of `dsh.profile.bundles`, append `"dsh-purge"` (skip if already there)

```json
{
  "name": "dsh-profile-web",
  "private": true,
  "dependencies": {

Keep JSON valid (comma before the new item, none after the last). Do not switch `file:../../plugins/dsh-purge` to an absolute path, do not touch `patchReload` or other plugins, and do not list `"dsh-purge"` twice. On desktop, if there is no `dsh-web-app` row, do not add one.

**4. Run `pnpm install` in that profile only** (`cd` into the profile dir, not the repo root or `$DSH_HOME`):

```sh
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web"   # or profiles/desktop
pnpm install
```

Success: `profiles/<web|desktop>/node_modules/dsh-purge/package.json` exists. If `pnpm` is missing, use the Node / pnpm shipped with official `dsh`; on `Could not resolve`, re-check the `file:` path; on a JSON error, fix commas or restore the backup.

**5. Fully quit that host, reopen it, then Apply** — Step 3 and Step 4 above. The card appears beside the session title; click **Apply** (or `/purge apply`) on that host only. If the card is missing, you likely edited the other `.dsh` — go back to step 1.

</details>

**Uninstall.** **dsh-purge** beside the session title → **Clean** → **Uninstall**. Confirm the dialog: it reverts any applied patches, restores the original Harness, and restarts the current host. Disable or uninstall also resets an agent-preset default that still points at `redteam` back to `standard`, so the host can create sessions after the preset is gone.
Uninstall commands and config ```sh
dsh-purge --uninstall

```

Plugin config lives in `cordis.patch.yml` (`postPrompt` is empty by default):

```yaml
- insert:

      name: 'dsh-purge'
      config:
        enabled: true
        autoApplyOnStart: true
        autoUpdateOnStart: false
        autoRevertOnMissing: false
        verbose: false
        postPromptOrder: 5100
        postPrompt: ""
```

</details>

---

**dsh-purge** sits beside the session title. It opens a right-hand dock with two pages: **Clean** and **Drill**. Switch **Light / Ink**. Patches are grouped; the count only includes items that actually applied. Rule sets sit in a list above the editor, with Enable and Delete on each row.

The first time you open Drill you read the notice, wait out the countdown, scroll to the end, and check three boxes. Clean does not need that step. Drill is only for a host you manage, an offline target, or an exercise that already has written authorization.

**Local lab**
The open-source build allows localhost/private nets by default. The Clean page says so. The only way to reach anything else is to enter that exact IP or hostname on the Local lab panel, one per line.

| Area | What it shows |
|---|---|
| dsh-purge | button beside the session title; opens or collapses the dock |
| Clean | patches, prompt, rule sets |
| Drill | assets and environment after authorization. This build does not ship skills or the knowledge base. The tab says Unauthorized until then |
| Patches | grouped status, Apply, Restore, or Uninstall |
| Prompt | edit `prompt-inject.md` as the session override |
| Local lab | loopback / RFC1918 only; names are resolved, and every address must be private |
| Rule sets | multiple `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md`; Enable writes under `$DSH_HOME`, Delete removes the row |

`bin/` is the CLI, `lib/` is patches and the drill console, `presets/redteam/` is the red-team preset, and `client.js` is the dock. This build does not ship `skills/` or the knowledge base.

Runtime files live under `$DSH_HOME`: `prompt-inject.md`, `rules/`, `redteam/`. If `DSH_HOME` is unset, the launcher-adjacent `.dsh` wins over `~/.dsh`. Web and the desktop app each use their own home.

---

```sh
dsh-purge --status
dsh-purge --apply
dsh-purge --revert
dsh-purge --uninstall
dsh-purge --edit

/purge status | apply | revert | uninstall | edit | help
/rules list | use <id> | create <id> | delete <id> | reset | help
/rewind

purge_status   purge_apply   purge_revert
```

After a successful Apply, the host restarts so patched packages load; you can also click **Restart** manually. Under the patch title are the stable release and the test release. The test release follows the `beta` branch. **Switch to stable** installs `master` and clears any pin. Picking an older stable version pins it; click **Update** to return to the latest. Old test tags are not listed.

The composer **Undo once** and **Undo last round** stay in the current conversation and do not open a branch. The sent line goes back into the input, and that cut's already-sent messages and completed tasks leave the current conversation; edit and **send again**. From **1.1.61**, rewind bounds follow the **current turn**, not the first user message. `/rewind` does the same.

If the **same task works in standard but fails in minimal or PTC**, preset `run_code`, sandbox, or plan intercept text is often still uncleared, or built-in minimal is missing `agent-instructions`. Use **1.1.61+**, then **quit the host fully → Apply in Clean → restart → start a new chat**. Switching preset alone does not reload patches in the running process.

DSH runs Bash calls in a tool batch one at a time. Older dsh-purge releases raised the default foreground wait from 60 seconds to 10 minutes, so one slow command could hold up later calls for that long. Patch #21 now restores marked plugin values to the official 60-second default. Unmarked timeouts and other custom values are preserved; an unmarked 10-minute value cannot reliably be distinguished from a user setting.

For a shorter wait in `dsh web` on macOS/Linux, add this entry to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (normally `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`). Edit an existing entry with the same id instead of adding a duplicate. This profile layer is applied after the bundled configuration, so future plugin applies keep the override.

```yaml
- id: bash-sandbox
  config:
    timeoutMs: 10000
```

With the standard jobs service and `promoteOnTimeout: true`, an unfinished command returns a background job id after 10 seconds and keeps running. Read it with `job_output` or stop it with `job_kill`. This changes the foreground wait, not the command's speed. Without that service or with promotion disabled, the timeout kills the command. A per-call `timeoutMs` overrides this default; `run_in_background: true` returns a job id immediately.

For routine tasks, you can also opt into Low reasoning for new sessions:

```yaml
- id: agent-default-model
  config:
    provider: deepseek-official
    model: deepseek-flash

Restart `dsh web` to load the profile. The model and reasoning defaults apply to newly created sessions; select Low in the composer for an existing session. The plugin does not change these model preferences automatically. Keep High when the task needs deeper reasoning, and narrow file searches rather than recursively scanning every application directory.

Attack tasks are denied by default. The open-source build only allows loopback and RFC1918 IPs. Names are resolved first; a `.lab` / `.htb` suffix is not enough. A hosts entry that points a lab name at a public IP is blocked. Saying “this is my server” in chat does not allow it — only an entry on the Local lab panel does.

---

- Each target is copied to `<file>.dshpurge.bak` before the first apply.
- **Restore** or `/purge revert` copies backups back and deletes them. With no backup, shim lines written by this plugin are stripped.
- `prompt-inject.md` is a user file and is kept.
- **Uninstall** restores first if patches were applied, then deletes the inject file, rule library, and the plugin itself.
- Apply is idempotent.

---

The host surface is detected first: `web` / `desktop` (`gui` / `tui` are reserved and still fall back to web).

**Web:**

1. `DSH_HOME` / `DSH_BASE`
2. `.dsh` next to the dsh launcher (portable install, any drive)
3. `npm prefix -g` / `npm root -g`
4. Nested `@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai`
5. `~/.dsh`

**Official desktop EXE:** the running official Harness install (`resources/app` or the unpacked package). The drive letter is not hard-coded. A successful Apply restarts once.

Community Desktop is not maintained.

Official npm-global is not patched. Sealed `host-commands` / `runtime-commands` are scrubbed, never injected.

If nothing is found, set `DSH_BASE` / `DSH_DESKTOP_INSTALL`. No files are changed.

Team channel: [t.me/LLM_PoJia](https://t.me/LLM_PoJia), used for announcements and updates. Upstream GitHub [Releases](https://github.com/HunYiSage/dsh-purge/releases) still hosts older packages. Resale of the original build is prohibited; forks must credit upstream and this branch.

- Scope is rendered copy, defaults, and runtime logic inside local `@deepseek-ai/*` packages, plus override files and rule sets under the harness home.
- After an upgrade, unmatched originals show as skipped. Apply still completes, and those files are left unchanged.
- Third-party plugin *source repos* outside `@deepseek-ai` are left alone (CMD silence may **best-effort** patch installed doctor / market / liangshen / mnemon at runtime).
- Install from the GitHub tarball (the name is not on npm; skip the plugin market). With `dsh`: `dsh plugin --profile web add https://codeload.github.com/lzzzz666888/dsh-purge-optimized/tar.gz/refs/heads/master`. pnpm only: `pnpm add` that URL inside `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web`. Use `desktop` for the EXE. From this repo, `add .`.

Harness 不只是把问题交给模型。它还会在运行时改提示词、审批门、沙箱和会话格式。只看「模型答不答」，会把宿主拦截误当成模型拒绝。这个插件在你自己的安装里把这两层分开，用来做受控评测，也用来看默认策略该不该收紧。

| 你会用到             | 它做什么                                            |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| **dsh-purge 侧栏** | 会话标题旁的按钮打开右侧栏。里面两页：清洗、演练台                       |
| **清洗**           | 分组查看补丁，应用、还原、卸载；编辑提示词和多套规则                      |
| **演练台**          | 正式版内置。授权后查看资产和本机环境。技能库与知识库随包分发。只用于本机/内网本地靶场 |
| **宿主策略**         | 调整默认文案、权限策略和工具上限。官方能力保留，不另写一套身份                 |
| **启动时**          | 自动再检查并应用。npm 升级盖掉 `node_modules` 之后不用手改文件       |

不写死盘符。按 `$DSH_HOME`、dsh 启动器旁边的 `.dsh`，再退回 `~/.dsh`。不改 Harness 源码仓库，在 **dsh-purge** 的「清洗」里点「应用」才写入。身份来自插件里的加密提示词，也就是提示词框默认显示的那一份。不读取宿主磁盘上的提示词文件。

本插件只处理使用者本机已安装的官方 `@deepseek-ai` 包和本机配置。它不是公网扫描器，也不是针对第三方站点的攻击套件。仓库内不含木马、未授权渗透脚本或对外攻击载荷。

对不上的补丁会显示待应用或跳过，不会乱改文件。

---
**不要走插件市场**：[dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org) 或设置里的「插件市场」一键安装会报 `already queued: dsh-purge`，命令也走不成。npm 仓库没有 `dsh-purge` 这个名字，不要 `pnpm add dsh-purge`。

PATH 里有 `dsh`？一条命令、一次重启、一次点击。跑你正在打开那一端的命令（桌面版把 `web` 换成 `desktop`）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://codeload.github.com/lzzzz666888/dsh-purge-optimized/tar.gz/refs/heads/master

dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://codeload.github.com/lzzzz666888/dsh-purge-optimized/tar.gz/refs/heads/master
```

1. **完全退出再打开**刚装的那个宿主。Web：停掉 `dsh web` 再开。桌面：托盘也要退出，再开 exe。
2. 在这个宿主点会话标题旁的 **dsh-purge** →「清洗」→「应用」。应用成功后会自动重启一次。

完成 —— 聊天里跑 `/purge status` 验证。如果 pnpm 问要不要允许构建、或者下面任何东西没出现，走后面的分步说明。

**第 1 步 —— 选定宿主。** 官方 `dsh web` 和官方桌面 EXE **分开装、分开应用**，只装你正在打开的那一个。

| 你正在用 | profile | 安装命令 |
|---|---|---|
| 官方 `dsh web` | `web` | 快速安装里 `web` 那条 |
| 官方桌面 EXE | `desktop` | 快速安装里 `desktop` 那条 |

**第 2 步 —— 装插件。** 压缩包地址只用 `codeload.github.com` 这个写法，不要用 `github.com/.../archive`：后者 302，pnpm 会 `fetch failed`。

有 `dsh`：跑快速安装里你那一端的命令。当前目录已是本仓库时，把网址换成 `.`。

只有 pnpm（没有 `dsh` 也行）：进正在用的那个 profile，不要在仓库根执行。

```sh
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web"    # 桌面改 profiles/desktop
pnpm add https://codeload.github.com/lzzzz666888/dsh-purge-optimized/tar.gz/refs/heads/master
```

Windows PowerShell：

```powershell
cd "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web"   # 桌面改 profiles\desktop
pnpm add https://codeload.github.com/lzzzz666888/dsh-purge-optimized/tar.gz/refs/heads/master
```

`pnpm add` 和 `dsh plugin add` 都会拉包；`postinstall` 再把 `dsh-purge` 写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，并在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 补上本体 `insert`（没有这一行，宿主不加载插件，界面也没有按钮）。

**完成标志：** `node_modules/dsh-purge/package.json` 在，该 profile 的 `bundles` 里有 `"dsh-purge"`，`cordis.patch.yml` 里有 `id: dsh-purge` 的 insert。

```sh

readme.text: Web 端把 `desktop` 换成 `web`。

**交给助手安装。** 把下面整段发给本机助手。它只执行安装命令：不要全盘搜索、不要改其它文件、不要代点「应用」、不要重启。
给 AI 助手（只安装） 安装 DeepSeek Harness 插件 `dsh-purge`，只装到 Web profile。不要全盘搜索，不要读或改其它文件，不要应用设置，也不要重启应用。不要装到桌面 profile。不要走插件市场。npm 仓库没有这个包名，不要 `pnpm add dsh-purge`。 **Web 端（官方 `dsh web`）** 有 `dsh`： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add https://codeload.github.com/lzzzz666888/dsh-purge-optimized/tar.gz/refs/heads/master ```

没有 `dsh`、只有 pnpm：找到 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web`（常见 `~/.dsh/profiles/web`），在该目录执行： ```sh pnpm add https://codeload.github.com/lzzzz666888/dsh-purge-optimized/tar.gz/refs/heads/master ``` 当前目录已是本仓库且有 `dsh` 时改用 `dsh plugin --profile web add .`。`dsh` 和 pnpm 都没有再告诉用户后停止。 命令结束后，提醒用户：完全退出并重启 `dsh web`，再点会话标题旁的 **dsh-purge**，在「清洗」里点「应用」。然后停止。 **手动安装。** 命令装不上、或 `dsh` 不在 PATH 时用这个。只改**正在用的那个宿主**对应的 profile，不要动另一个，也不要删原有 bundle。

完整手动步骤 **1. 找到真正在用的 `$DSH_HOME`。** 认目录：名字是 `.dsh`（官方 EXE 偶见 `dsh-home`），里面有 `profiles`，且至少有一个 `profiles/<名>/package.json`。按顺序找：`DSH_HOME` 环境变量 → 安装根旁边的 `.dsh`（便携包）→ `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh` 或 `~/.dsh` → `%APPDATA%` / `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeek Harness\dsh-home`。确认：`profiles/web/package.json` 里 `"name"` 是 `dsh-profile-web`（桌面是 `dsh-profile-desktop`）。本机常有两份 `.dsh`，要用你**实际启动**的那个宿主对应的那份。 Windows PowerShell 列候选：

```powershell
$cands = @()
if ($env:DSH_HOME) { $cands += $env:DSH_HOME }
$cands += "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh"
$dsh = Get-Command dsh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

**2. 把插件放到 `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-purge`**（目录名必须是 `dsh-purge`，其 `package.json` 里 `"name"` 也必须是 `dsh-purge`）。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/lzzzz666888/dsh-purge-optimized.git "$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-purge"
```

没有 git：下载 [master.tar.gz](https://github.com/lzzzz666888/dsh-purge-optimized/archive/refs/heads/master.tar.gz)，解压后把 `dsh-purge-master` 改名为 `dsh-purge`，整夹放到 `plugins` 下。已有本仓库副本就复制整个目录，不要只拷几个 `.js`。

**3. 只改对应 profile 的 `package.json`，先备份。** Web → `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json`；桌面 → `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/package.json`。**只追加两处**，原有依赖和 bundle 全部留着：

1. `dependencies` 增加 `"dsh-purge": "file:../../plugins/dsh-purge"`
2. `dsh.profile.bundles` **末尾**追加 `"dsh-purge"`（已有就不要再加）

```json
{
  "name": "dsh-profile-web",
  "private": true,
  "dependencies": {

JSON 要合法（新增项前面有逗号，最后一项后面没有多余逗号）。`file:../../plugins/dsh-purge` 不要改成绝对路径，`patchReload`、其它插件、版本号都不要动，`"dsh-purge"` 不要写两次。桌面端没有 `dsh-web-app` 就不要硬加。

**4. 只在刚改的那个 profile 目录装依赖**（`cd` 进 profile 目录，不要在仓库根或 `$DSH_HOME` 根）：

```sh
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web"   # 或 profiles/desktop
pnpm install
```

成功标志：出现 `profiles//node_modules/dsh-purge/package.json`。找不到 `pnpm` 就用官方 `dsh` 自带的 Node / pnpm；报 `Could not resolve` 就检查 `file:` 路径；JSON 解析失败就修逗号或还原备份。 **5. 完全退出该宿主，再启动，再点「应用」** —— 即第 3 步和第 4 步。按钮会出现在会话标题旁，只在这个宿主点「应用」（或 `/purge apply`）。没出现多半是改错了另一份 `.dsh`，回到第 1 步核对。 **卸载。** 会话标题旁的 **dsh-purge** →「清洗」→「卸载」。弹窗确认：会先还原已应用的补丁，还原回原版 Harness，再重启当前宿主。停用或卸载时会把「智能体预设」里指向红队模式的默认值改回 `standard`，避免宿主因找不到 `redteam` 而无法新建会话。

设置页「应用」成功后会自动重启，以加载已改的包文件；也可手动点「重启」。补丁标题下有正式版和测试版。测试版跟 `beta` 分支。点「切换到正式版」会装回 master，并清掉钉选。正式版里选旧版本会固定在该版本，要回到最新再点「更新」。旧的测试标签不再列出。

输入框旁的「回退一次」和「回退上一轮」都留在当前这条对话里，不另开分支。已发送的那句会回到输入框，这一轮已经发出的内容和已完成的任务会从当前对话撤掉，改字后**重新发送**即可。从 **1.1.61** 起，多轮对话后回退按**当前这一轮**定位，不会又退到第一条用户消息。聊天里 `/rewind` 同样可用。

**极简 / PTC 与标准不一致时**：同一任务在标准模式能跑、在极简或 PTC 被拦，通常是 preset 里 `run_code` 或 plan 拦截句没洗净，或内置 minimal 缺少 `agent-instructions`。请升到 **1.1.61+**，**完全退出宿主 → 清洗里应用 → 自动重启 → 新开一轮对话** 再试；只换 preset 不重应用，旧进程里的补丁不会更新。

DSH 会按顺序执行同一批中的 Bash 调用。旧版 dsh-purge 把默认前台等待从 60 秒提高到了 10 分钟，一条慢命令会让后续调用一起等待。补丁 #21 现在把带插件标记的旧值恢复为官方的 60 秒。无标记的等待时间和其他自定义值会保留；无标记的 10 分钟无法可靠地区分是插件旧值还是用户设置。

在 macOS/Linux 的 `dsh web` 中，如需更快返回工具结果，可在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`（通常是 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`）添加下面的条目。已有相同 id 时修改原条目，不要重复添加。这个 profile 覆盖层在内置配置之后加载，后续应用插件会保留它。

```yaml
- id: bash-sandbox
  config:
    timeoutMs: 10000
```

使用标准 jobs 服务且 `promoteOnTimeout: true` 时，未完成的命令会在 10 秒后返回后台任务 id，并继续运行。用 `job_output` 读取结果、用 `job_kill` 停止。这个设置缩短前台等待，不会让命令本身跑得更快。没有 jobs 服务或关闭自动转后台时，超时会终止命令。单次调用传入的 `timeoutMs` 优先于这里的默认值；`run_in_background: true` 可立即返回任务 id。

日常任务还可以选择让新会话默认使用 Low 推理：

```yaml
- id: agent-default-model
  config:
    provider: deepseek-official
    model: deepseek-flash

重启 `dsh web` 后加载配置。模型和推理等级默认值只用于新建会话，已有会话请在输入框中选择 Low。插件不会自动修改这些模型偏好。需要深入推理的任务可保留 High；搜索文件时应限定目录，避免递归扫描所有应用目录。

开源版攻击任务默认全拦，只放行本机/私网 IP。域名先解析再判，不认 `.lab` / `.htb` 这类后缀本身。hosts 把实验室名指到公网 IP 也会拦。在对话里说「这是我的服务器」不会放行 —— 只有「本地靶场」里登记的条目才会。

- 每个目标文件在应用前备份为 `<文件>.dshpurge.bak`。
- 「还原」或 `/purge revert` 用备份覆盖回去并删除备份；没有备份时去掉 shim 里由本插件写入的行。
- `prompt-inject.md` 是用户文件，还原时保留。
- 「卸载」会先还原（若已应用），再删除注入文件、规则库和插件本身。
- 重复应用是幂等的。
